critical_code_review_comments: prop_settlement._mlb_find_game — Selection priority (Final > Live > other, then event_time-distance, then earliest gameDate) is well-documented and correctly implemented. Verified with fabricated Phillies@Tigers 07-11/07-12 series fixture: chooses 07-12 for event_time 07-12 and 07-11 for event_time 07-11.

prop_settlement._mlb_stat_for_player — Position-aware routing: pitchers get pitching block for strikeOuts/baseOnBalls/runs; hitters get batting block for the same fields. Batting-only stats (hits, HR, RBI, TB) and pitching-only stats (outs, IP, ER) route unambiguously. Docstring at :293-317 clearly explains the Wheeler bug. Well-implemented.
prop_settlement._MARKET_STATS — Order matters: 'outs recorded' before 'runs scored' before 'runs', 'total bases' before 'home runs' before 'home run' (singular). Ordering is preserved.

prop_settlement combo-market branch (line 947) — 'hits + runs + rbi' inline sum path is correct: reads all three stats via _mlb_stat_for_player, sums (None → 0), skips only if all three are None. Matches the Turner 07-02 case (1+0+0=1>0.5=won).

grading_validator._mlb_verify_prop — Full parity with settler: same D+D-1 merge, AND-team match (was OR before), event_time-distance selection, position-aware routing, combo-market sum. Validator can now truly cross-check the settler.
stuck_pick_reaper.py:72 — Query correctly excludes {"grade_disagreement": {"$exists": False}} so the reaper never voids picks the validator has reopened for re-settlement.
grading_validator._run_cross_check agreement branch (line 315-318) — Correctly $unsets grade_disagreement on agreement; the stale-flag issue reported in iter70 is fixed.

rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration verifies a fix. Root cause of the iter70 bug (documented in iteration_70.json) was: (1) _mlb_find_game selected the wrong game in a series when two games shared teams (07-11 vs 07-12 Wheeler), (2) _mlb_stat_for_player read pitcher K/BB/runs from the batting block (which is populated with 0 for the plate appearances) instead of the pitching block, (3) the combo market 'Hits + Runs + RBIs' only read hits, (4) the cross-source validator had OR team match + no event_time distance, so it agreed with the settler's wrong answer for a subset and disagreed but the settler kept re-writing the wrong answer for the 82 flagged. Iter71 fix addresses all four with position-aware routing + event_time-distance + AND-team + combo sum in BOTH the settler and validator. Post-fix DB is clean: 0 remaining grade_disagreement flags; Wheeler/Altuve/Machado/Turner all now match MLB Stats API.
